<thought>Using the most intense ESI peak at m/z 233.9632 as [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is 232.9559 Da. Matching this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈7 % M+1, ≈10 % M+2) suggests a formula with about 7 carbons and two sulfurs (each S contributes ~4 % to M+2). The formula C₇H₅O₅S₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 232.957842 Da, within 2 mDa of the measured mass, and its predicted isotopic pattern aligns with the data. Therefore the molecular formula is C7H5O5S2.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H5O5S2</final_answer>
